inner_split: Permute unique outer-training person IDs using seed_base+outer_fold, then split into four equal 35-person groups. No labels used in split.
selection_metric: front-window person-macro MAE pooled over inner out-of-person predictions for 140 outer-training people
tie_rule: smallest k within 1e-12 of minimum inner MAE
scaler_fit: each inner training group only; refit on outer training group after k selection
pca_fit: each inner training group only, full float64 centered SVD, no whitening; refit after selection
training_loss: record-equal squared error plus alpha times coefficient L2 norm; intercept unpenalized
